questions.q: Which process is the wearing down of a river's load into smaller, rounder pieces?
questions.why: Attrition is when load particles collide and break down; abrasion wears the bed and banks.

questions.q: On the inside of a meander bend you would expect to find:
options: A slip-off slope formed by deposition
questions.why: Water is slower on the inside of the bend, so material is deposited to form a slip-off slope.

questions.q: What is lag time on a flood hydrograph?
options: Time between peak rainfall and peak discharge
Time from the start of rainfall to the end of the flood
questions.why: Lag time is the delay between the highest rainfall and the highest river discharge.

questions.q: Explain how afforestation can reduce the risk of flooding.
questions.model: Trees intercept rainfall and take up water through their roots, so less water reaches the river quickly. This lengthens lag time and lowers peak discharge.
points: less/slower runoff so lower peak discharge
